meta.name: The Unlikely Murderer
meta.description: After the assassination of prime minister Olof Palme in 1986, Stig Engström managed to elude justice right up to his death through a combination of audacity, luck, and a perplexed police force.

videos.title: Episode 1
videos.overview: Shortly after Palme's assassination, Engström begins his quest for attention as a crime-scene witness. Divisions among police hinder the investigation.

videos.title: Episode 2
videos.overview: Realizing Engström's story doesn't add up, Irvell starts turning up the heat. Decades after the murder, a journalist starts reinvestigating the case.

videos.title: Episode 3
videos.overview: Irvell's steady methods turn up more evidence to implicate Engström, but Holmér's stubborn tunnel vision leads investigators into a dead end.

videos.title: Episode 4
videos.overview: Police railroad another suspect. Desperate for more attention, Engström continues to speak out. Thomas tries to connect Engström to the gun.

videos.title: Episode 5
videos.overview: His mental health deteriorating, Engström's life falls to pieces. Years later, a prosecutor revisits the case and makes a momentous announcement.

meta.slogan: Based on the real assassination on prime minister Olof Palme.
